title_zh: 核对答卷后改正漏计的一分

scenario.goal_zh: 根据答卷逐项核对并更正漏计的得分

context_zh: 学生发现测验总分可能少算，和老师逐项检查。
author: author-phase04-b

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: Could we check my score? There are eight ticks on the page, but the total says seven.

sentences.speaker: Mr Wu
sentences.text: Let me count them. You are right; I missed the last answer when I added them.

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: So it should be eight out of ten?

sentences.speaker: Mr Wu
sentences.text: Yes. I have corrected the total on your paper and in my record. Thank you for checking.
